result.title: A Simple Yet Effective Agent for Open-World Aerial Object Search
result.summary: Open-world aerial object search methods often rely on persistent spatial maps, learned world models, or task-specific policy training. To examine how far a minimal, training-free design can go, we introduce SimpleUAV, an agent built around a frozen, off-the-shelf vision-language model (VLM). SimpleUAV separates current-view target assessment from history-conditioned action selection, combining fresh candidate evidence with lightweight search context. Local geometry converts visual selections into bounded straight-line movements, depth-based checks halt blocked segments, and measured execution feedback guides subsequent decisions. This closed loop sustains search without persistent spatial maps or task-specific training. SimpleUAV achieves 41.61% Success Rate (SR) on UAV-ON and 11.98% on AerialDojo-200K, compared with 23.80% and 3.20% for the strongest prior baselines, respectively. With limited benchmark-specific adaptation, the same core agent transfers to aerial Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) on TravelUAV, improving Full SR by at least 19.66% across all three splits under L1 assistance. These results establish a strong baseline for evaluating when additional architectural complexity benefits aerial search.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 SimpleUAV，一个以冻结 VLM 为核心、无需任务训练与持久空间地图的 UAV 开放世界目标搜索 agent：把当前视图的目标评估与依赖历史的动作选择分开，并用局部几何、深度检查和执行反馈构成闭环搜索。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「当前证据评估 / 历史条件决策」的解耦与按执行反馈中止受阻片段，可供核查 LVR 中 LOOK 与 STOP 的条件分离及停止判据设计；但工作面向机器人式搜索应用，未涉及内部 latent 状态的生成或使用。
